results.name: Stranger Things
results.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

results.name: Stranger Things: Tales from '85
results.overview: Winter. Hawkins. 1985. Welcome back to a town crawling with secrets, where beloved heroes are facing fresh mysteries... and an all-new breed of strange.

results.name: Beyond Stranger Things
results.overview: Secrets from the "Stranger Things 2" universe are revealed as cast and guests discuss the latest episodes with host Jim Rash. Caution: spoilers ahead!

results.title: Stranger Things: Tales from '85 Theatrical Preview
results.original_title: Stranger Things: Tales from '85 Theatrical Preview
results.overview: In the winter of 1985, snow blankets the town and the horrors of the Upside Down are finally fading. Our heroes Eleven, Mike, Will, Dustin, Lucas, and Max have settled back into a normal life of D&D, snowball fights, and quiet days. But beneath the ice, something terrifying has awakened. A special limited theatrical screening of the first two episodes.

results.title: Stranger Things
results.overview: Oona, a recent graduate in anthropology, has returned to her dead mother’s seaside cottage in southern England to prepare it for sale. Her arrival disturbs Mani, a wary vagrant who has been squatting on the property.

results.title: Stranger Things: Fireplace
results.overview: Gather 'round the fireplace in Hawkins, where the flames crackle, the alphabet glows — and the holidays get turned Upside Down.

results.title: Stranger Things: The First Shadow
results.overview: In 1959 Hawkins, Indiana, Henry Creel hopes for a fresh start. His romance with outsider Patty Newby brings newfound hope, until local crimes force him to question if he's connected to the town's unfolding horrors. Filmed live from the Marquis Theatre in New York City between February 10–14, 2026.

results.title: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
results.original_title: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
results.overview: An inside look at the years of effort and craft that went into the final installment of the Duffer Brothers' generation-defining series.

results.title: Behind the Curtain: Stranger Things: The First Shadow
results.original_title: Behind the Curtain: Stranger Things: The First Shadow
results.overview: Go behind the scenes with the cast and crew of “Stranger Things: The First Shadow”, the award-winning live stage show that expands the Hawkins universe.

results.title: Stranger Things Have Happened to Me
results.original_title: Stranger Things Have Happened to Me
results.overview: Antonio is jealous of his new teammate, Stephon, who has kindled a connection with his girlfriend Mya. His anger fuels the fire that stirs up hidden truths and unravels a long list of lies and deception causing chaos around the college campus.

results.title: The Science(ish) of… Stranger Things
results.overview: Comedian Sophie Duker, science nerd Rick Edwards and quantum physicist Dr Michael Brooks dissect the science of Netflix’s Stranger Things, sorting the nanoscience from the nonsense.

results.title: Skinwalkers and Stranger Things of the Unseen Realm
results.original_title: Skinwalkers and Stranger Things of the Unseen Realm
results.overview: Do Stranger Things, Remote Viewing, Skinwalker Ranch, and UFOs have something in common? Are there Sinister Forces at work, and do they have an agenda? Let's dive in and see how these topics tie into the Occult and Demonic, and ultimately what their agenda might be. Parental Guidance suggested.

results.title: The Upside Down Collector's Item
results.overview: November 6, 1983 – Hawkins, Indiana… It's time to rescue Will Byers from the Upside Down! Lucas Sinclair, Dustin Henderson, Mike Wheeler, Eleven, Joyce Byers, and Chief Hopper are ready to drive the Demogorgon out of the Byers' house—are you? Build the LEGO 75810 The Upside Down collection and uncover its secrets, recreating the spine-chilling scene from the award-winning Netflix original series Stranger Things.
